children: R F INDUSTRIES LTD reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue rising to $23.96M and diluted earnings per share of $0.12, driven by stronger demand for custom cabling and interconnects and higher project volume versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Consolidated net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Income (loss) per share”.
Revenue growth of 21.1% in the quarter and 9.9% year-to-date was led by stronger custom cabling and interconnect demand.
Higher orders from a tier‑one carrier and gains in aerospace and industrial segments increased project volume.
Operational actions — restructuring, manufacturing consolidation and a unified sales model — improved margins to about 35% and supported profitability.
Backlog expanded to $18.6M, indicating a solid project pipeline though timing remains sensitive for small cell deployments.
